translation:
In a sense, it wouldn't be mistaken to call this
the most appropriate and safe group.

With Asahina, who is the most normal out of
anyone…

And Koizumi, who acts suspiciously but has
good common sense.
Quite surprising.
What's surprising?

I thought you might go together with Miss
Suzumiya.

I suppose you have to be prepared for the
unexpected, right?

I've got Nagato with her to keep things under
control.

I'm not honestly sure if she'll actually keep
her under control, but…

She'll step in before it gets too serious,
right?

Whatever Nagato does, we can make up an
excuse for it later.
I'm sorry for mixing you up in all this, Asahina.
Not at all. You haven't done anything wrong…

I'll do whatever I can. Just as long as it
doesn't require any classified information…

I'm also a member of the SOS Brigade, after
all.

I'm so glad I chose Asahina, truly from the
bottom of my heart. No, seriously.
What shall we do? You are the commander.
Why me?
You're the one that came across class 1-10.
Even though it was unintentional.

You're the one person who shares having
seen class 1-10 with that club member.

We'll go ask them about it again, and use that
information to "disprove” their little story.

In other words, we're trying to find
inconsistencies in their words, right?
To put it bluntly, yes.

But… I think they're pretty wary of us. I
wonder if we'll be okay…

Asahina makes an astute point. Just as she
says, they're wary of us, the SOS Brigade.

Who knows whether we'll get anything more out
of them…

We certainly can't just barge in on them so
suddenly. Let's first devise a strategy.
You're right…
There's a rationale behind Koizumi's words.

It would be problematic for us to just strut on
over there and get turned away at the door.
Okay, let's have a strategy meeting.

It would probably be best if we relocated. Miss
Suzumiya may pass through here.
Every little thing he says is right.

Although preferably, I'd like you to persuade
Haruhi with your finely crafted points instead.

Let's go to the clubroom, where we can lock
the door.

With that said, the three of us reassembled in
the clubroom. However…

Hold on, isn't the computer society only really
concerned about Haruhi?

I believe it is all of us in the SOS Brigade,
including Miss Suzumiya.

It was before I joined, but the event where
their PC was taken really upset them.
I-I don't want to remember that…

Asahina seems to want to forget it. I can
sympathize.

Based on that, they're likely not overly wary
of me.

That may be the first step in getting the
computer society to open up to us.

Certainly, Koizumi's mastery of speech might
get them to lower their defenses.

I knew it… They're afraid of me, aren't they?
That thing happened, after all.

Actually, rather than being afraid, I think
they just feel bad for you.
Wait a sec, they feel bad for Asahina?

It's unfair to Asahina, but we could leverage
that to get them to talk to us…
What should I do? What's the best strategy?

We should take the reliable route here. It's
safest to leave it to Koizumi, after all.
Koizumi, can I leave it to you?

Give the computer society a reason to speak
with us.
I'll give it a go.

Fortunately, I'm not averse to computer-
related topics either.
Really?
Indeed, I have a little interest myself.

What do you mean a little interest? You should
join the computer society in that case.

…I'm sorry, but I'm going to have to rely on
Asahina here just this once.

I'm sorry, Asahina… I think we're going to
need your help.
Uh-umm, what kind of help?

I think the guys at the computer society feel
bad for you.
I think they'll listen if it's you asking.
R-really?

I'll leave it to Koizumi for the time being, but
after that, if you could do what you can…

Essentially, I'll get a foot in the door, and the
rest will be up to Miss Asahina, is that right?
Is that okay with you?
Eehh… I'll do my best.
You guys again?! What is it this time?!

As expected, the club president came out to
meet us with unabashed wariness.
Oh…

The club president pulled a painfully awkward
face when he saw Asahina.
H-hello.
Oh… H-hi.

We're sorry for the interruption, but we'd like
to ask you some more questions.
Can't you just be reasonable with us?
We've told you many times that we're busy.

You're getting in the way of our work, so
can't you leave us alone?

You seem to be quite busy. What are you
making?
…That's none of your business, is it?

Indeed, it's purely my personal interest. Are
you programming something?
Yeah, but…are you seriously interested?

Seriously. I'm not too familiar with this kind of
thing yet, but…
Hmm…

Feels like his attitude softened a little to
that response. Nice one, Koizumi.

If I had to guess, it seems like you're making
some kind of application.

Sort of. Though rather than an application,
it's game software.

I see. I suppose that's why you have all this
equipment.

Do you understand our PC specs? Like, how
amazing they are…?

They seem fairly customized. It looks like you
have some self-made parts inside too.

We do. We do indeed. Look, like that
white-cased PC.

In pre-builts some of the parts are rather
weak, so you need to mod them.

…Well, the best one was stolen by your
brigade chief.
Ahh, that's rough.

Koizumi's really gotten hold of a
conversational lead. Now's our chance.

You also said you want to learn about using
computers, didn't you, Asahina?
Huh? M-me?

Speaking through my eyes, I told Asahina to
go along with it.

O-oh yes, that's right! I still don't know very
much though…
Wanna try them out?

Our PCs have pretty much all the software
you'd ever want to use.
They're fully equipped with software, too?

Well, as much as we can manage at least,
considering our club's budget.

But there's also our personal purchases, and
we're making good use of freeware.

Hey, let her use the open computer. She's a
novice.
Huh? But prez, she's…

Ah…yeah. It's fine. Just forget about that
for now.
Huh. Well, if you say so, Prez.
D-don't mind me…

Seems like Asahina has somehow integrated
herself into their group. Impressive as always.

I've heard making a game is hard. You have to
make sure it's balanced and such…

Yeah, you're right. That's the most troubling
aspect for us.

It takes a lot of trial and error before it
finally takes shape. It's a pain.

Are you saying you spent all summer making
it?
It's whatever.

We lost part of the data, and eventually had
no choice but to remake it.
Seriously… Where did it go? That memory card.
Memory card?
The memory card with our backups.

Look, it's exactly like the card she's trying to
use right now.

Saying this, the club president was pointing
at an Asahina in a scuffle with the computer.
I-I just put this in? Right here?
No, umm, that's USB, so…
Yew-ess-bee?
No no, not there, it's this slot.
Here… Maybe? Is it here?
Yes yes! There!

It won't recognize it if it's not connected
properly, so be careful. Well, it's probably fine.
Asahina seems to totally blend in here.

That's right, I think Asahina has done her
part.

Now I just have to ask them about the
unnatural phenomena…
I'd like to be a part of this discussion as well.
You're also interested in computer programs?

Well, if I had to say, I'm interested as a user. I
don't care about making them.

He's the one that updates the SOS Brigade's
homepage.
Huh… You do?

I'll leave aside whether you can call that
"updating,” but I at least changed the logo.

When you say user, do you mean of
applications or games? Which one?
Games, maybe.

Huh, really? Well, most of our club members like
games, including myself.
What about you, Koizumi?

With games, I'm more of the tabletop sort. I'm
quite invested when it comes to board games.

Ah, now that you mention it, you're often
playing Othello or card games in the clubroom.
Well, tabletop is good too.

Wait, what is Asahina learning from the
computer society guys?
Um, well…
What are you learning, Asahina?
Ah, Kyon.

Right now I'm learning how to save a drawing I
did myself.

If you only save it on the internal hard drive,
you won't be able to take it back with you.

I'll show you how to upload it over the internet
as well.

I-I can't learn so much all at once, so, one at
a time please…

You're supposed to be from the future, so
this PC should be a mere ancient relic to you…

Then again, this generation of PCs might be
so old it's new.
What did you draw?
It's a secret. I couldn't draw it very well.

What are you saying? If Asahina drew it, it's
definitely a masterpiece in my eyes.

It's nice that we've got some conversation
going, but we still haven't gotten to the point.

I'd like to start asking about the unnatural
phenomena soon…
Suddenly, my phone started ringing.

Haruhi's name was written all over the LCD
display in large text. Good grief.
…Hello?

Oi, Kyon! Where are you and what are you
doing?! Get your ass back here right now!
We're still in the heat of questioning.

Still?! You're taking forever! There's no point
in dragging it out this long!

This is a summer camp, so it's important to act
as a group! Come back immediately!
Like I said, we're still asking questions… Hey!
…She hung up.
Was that from Miss Suzumiya?

Who else? She said that's enough questioning,
and that we should head back.
What will you do?

I wouldn't be surprised if Haruhi starts being
unreasonable again, so we'll take a break.

I think that's a wise decision. In my opinion, at
least.

Why is it that I feel zero pleasure whatsoever
when Koizumi praises me, I wonder…
Asahina, let's head back now.
Wait, but… we still haven't…

That call just now, it was Haruhi saying to
come straight back.
Oh, I see. Understood.

You're done already? I haven't even taught
you file compression techniques yet…
Please teach me in detail another time.
Sorry for interrupting you.
Ahh, well it's been a nice reprieve for us too.

We ended up leaving without getting any
clues…

Well, whatever. We'll just make up some lie that
class 1-10 is a fake.
…Hm?

Just as we were leaving after our veni, vidi,
no vici, I noticed a strange object.
Kyon? Is something wrong?

No, I just feel like there's something lying
under your feet…
Under… my feet?

Asahina swiftly lifted her foot and under it
was…
This is… a memory card, right?
Could it be the club president's…?
He said he lost it, didn't he?

He'll probably be overjoyed when we bring it
back.
Should I go return it to him?
We should do it while we still can…
Wait a moment, Miss Asahina.

Perhaps we can use that memory card for
something.

For what? Are you saying we should steal it
and put it in the clubroom PC?

Not quite that. It could serve as material to
distract Miss Suzumiya…is what I'm thinking.

I think she'd naturally be interested in the
con- tents of a memory card found lying around.

Well, whether or not she'd look inside, she'd
definitely be interested.

But… It's the club president's property,
right?
I think it probably is.
I think we should give it back.

Of course, I think so too, but… I can't ignore
what Koizumi's saying either.

What should I do? Should I return it to the
president?
…Let's borrow it, just for a bit.

Of course, just for a little bit. I'll leave it in
your hands.
I-I wonder if that's really okay…
Do you mind returning it, Asahina?
No, of course I don't mind.
Is that really okay? To just give it back?

I have a guilty conscience after all. I don't
want to become a luggage thief.

If you say so, then I suppose we have no
choice… Although it's a bit of a shame.
Okay then, I'll go return it.

That club president, did he really not notice
it, even though it was right under his nose?

That's the meaning of "it is darkest under
the lamp post,” is it not?
Well, I think it's just negligence…
Leave it to Koizumi
Rely on Asahina
Join Koizumi's conversation
Go to Mikuru's side
Keep it for now
Return it to the president
